closureReview.note: The current 18-case catalog is local-only. No case is VERIFIED and no production permission is granted.

scopeDecisions.recommendation: Require firebase 12.18.0 Web SDK in Node gRPC and a real browser in both WebChannel modes. Mobile SDKs remain outside the declared SDK matrix. Correct the stale parent-row mobile wording before freezing.
Assign cross-tenant principal/claim decisions to AUTH-FS-CROSS and FS-RULES; retain the catalog 108/108C default-tenant cross-principal listener delivery here.
Keep direct gRPC raw resume-token behavior as a separate condition; SDK-managed resume cannot establish it.
Keep real browser tab lifecycle as a separate condition because the 18-case browser shadows do not close or reload a tab.
Record production behavior for case 109 before deciding whether the local post-revocation unauthenticated event is a defect or an accepted divergence.

Use the Identity Platform sandbox only with the FS-RULES owner of its Firestore and Rules state; otherwise select a separately authorized sandbox configuration. Do not reuse the historical-project manifest.

productionPlan.projectSelectionReason: Owner OL-3 selected query/(default), deployed conformance/firestore.rules and existing Auth. Serialize with STORAGE and FUNCTIONS via shared lock.
productionPlan.browserWireBaselineExplanation: One local receipt per browser mode used 915 long-polling and 473 streaming WebChannel requests. Doubling their sum gives a 2776-request baseline for the proposed two recordings per mode; Node, Auth, Rules, setup and cleanup requests are additional.
productionPlan.additionalCorpusEstimate: ExistenceFilter/BloomFilter, backend-mediated cache, native target protocol, metadata changes, limitToLast and browser tab lifecycle remain unestimated until finite runners and controls are defined.
productionPlan.cleanup: Close every listener, client and browser process; conditionally delete owned conf_* documents and both throwaway accounts, then read back typed absence and preserve unknown resources for recovery. Deployed Rules are unchanged.
prerequisites: FS-DATA-WRITE closure and exclusive query/(default) scheduling with STORAGE and FUNCTIONS
Migrate the catalog and all local adapters to conf_listen and conf_rules_owner without changing deployed Rules; preserve historical receipts
Production-capable source-bound SDK and browser adapters with all-wire accounting and finite request cap
Finite native target, cache, ExistenceFilter, metadata and limitToLast corpus with local shadow and clean-context review
Twice-recorded sandbox packet, JSONL ledger admission and owner permission
